question: When must an invoice be placed in HOLD status?
answer_text: An invoice must be placed in HOLD status if any of the following conditions are not met: the vendor must be in Approved Status, the vendor's Certificate of Insurance (COI) must be current and not expired, the invoice must reference a valid Purchase Order or Service Agreement, the work or materials referenced in the invoice must be confirmed received by the assigned BlueRiver project owner, and the invoice line items must match the Purchase Order within an acceptable variance (5% on labor, 0% on materials unless documented in writing). An invoice in HOLD status must not be entered into QuickBooks until the missing condition is satisfied [chunk_id=41].
